Mapping from BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes to be-diagnostic-report-diabetes

Source elementRelationshipTarget elementComment
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.businessIdentifierequivalentDiagnosticReport.identifierAt least one identifier is required, including the UUID slice with system fixed to be-ns-diagnostic-report-diabetes. Slicing is open, so other business identifiers can be added.
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.recordedDateequivalentDiagnosticReport.extension:recorded-date
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.observationPeriodequivalentDiagnosticReport.effective[x]effective[x] is restricted to Period; start and end are both mandatory.
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.patientequivalentDiagnosticReport.subjectReference(BePatient). For GDPR reasons, sensor suppliers may not use the NISS of their users in external communication.
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.statusequivalentDiagnosticReport.statusBound to BeVSDiabetesReportStatus. The value is assigned according to the business rule on % Data Captured.
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.recorderequivalentDiagnosticReport.extension:recorderReference(BePractitioner | BeOrganization). The professional is identified by INAMI or national register number, the organization by INAMI approval or company number.
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.interpreterequivalentDiagnosticReport.resultsInterpreterReference(BePractitionerRole | BePractitioner). Not provided by the report producer; added by the interpreting care provider.
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.categoryequivalentDiagnosticReport.categoryBound (preferred) to BeVSDiabetesReportCategory.
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.deviceTypeequivalentDiagnosticReport.extension:devicevalueCodeableConcept bound (extensible) to BeVSDiabetesDeviceType. The individual sensor device is mentioned in the measurement observation.
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.codeequivalentDiagnosticReport.codeBound to BeVSDiabetesReportCode (e.g. 439926003 Ambulatory continuous glucose monitoring of interstitial tissue fluid).
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.derivedObservationsequivalentDiagnosticReport.resultReference(BeObservationDiabetes).
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.measuredDiabetesObservationsequivalentDiagnosticReport.resultReference(BeObservationDiabetes). Shares DiagnosticReport.result with the derived observations; there is no separate slice yet.
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.noteequivalentDiagnosticReport.extension:noteNot provided by the report producer; added by the interpreting care provider.
BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes.documentequivalentDiagnosticReport.presentedFormcontentType fixed to application/pdf.

name: MapDiagnosticReportDiabetes
title: Diabetes Report Model to BeDiagnosticReportDiabetes Mapping
description: Mapping from the BeModelDiagnosticReportDiabetes logical model to the be-diagnostic-report-diabetes profile

target.comment: At least one identifier is required, including the UUID slice with system fixed to be-ns-diagnostic-report-diabetes. Slicing is open, so other business identifiers can be added.

element.display: Date of the last update of the report
From date to date corresponding to the period covered by the report. Typically 14 to 30 days. See business rules

target.comment: effective[x] is restricted to Period; start and end are both mandatory.

element.display: The patient that this report is about

target.display: The subject of the report - usually, but not always, the patient
target.comment: Reference(BePatient). For GDPR reasons, sensor suppliers may not use the NISS of their users in external communication.

element.display: Report status, by default “Final”. The value is assigned according to the business rule on “% Data Captured”

target.comment: Bound to BeVSDiabetesReportStatus. The value is assigned according to the business rule on % Data Captured.

element.display: The healthcare professional (INAMI number / national register number) or organization (INAMI approval number / company number) that encodes the information and takes responsibility for its content

target.comment: Reference(BePractitioner | BeOrganization). The professional is identified by INAMI or national register number, the organization by INAMI approval or company number.

element.display: Healthcare provider (INAMI number / national register number) who added an interpretation to the report (e.g. endocrinologist, general practitioner). Not provided by the producer of the report

target.comment: Reference(BePractitionerRole | BePractitioner). Not provided by the report producer; added by the interpreting care provider.

element.display: Category of the report. At least one category must be assigned

Identification number assigned by INAMI to the type of sensor model used to create the observations on which the report is based. The individual sensor device is mentioned in the measurement observation

target.comment: valueCodeableConcept bound (extensible) to BeVSDiabetesDeviceType. The individual sensor device is mentioned in the measurement observation.

element.display: Report code - indicating the type of procedure that leads to the production of the primary values of this report, i.e. 439926003 | Ambulatory continuous glucose monitoring of interstitial tissue fluid

target.comment: Bound to BeVSDiabetesReportCode (e.g. 439926003 Ambulatory continuous glucose monitoring of interstitial tissue fluid).

element.display: List of references to “derived values” type observations (a dozen derived observations) mentioned in the report. These observations are part of the diagnostic report
References to the measured diabetes observations (a few thousand measurements) used to produce the analysis

target.comment: Reference(BeObservationDiabetes). Shares DiagnosticReport.result with the derived observations; there is no separate slice yet.

element.display: Report comments in free text format. Not provided by the producer of the report, but by the healthcare provider doing the interpretation

target.comment: Not provided by the report producer; added by the interpreting care provider.

element.display: PDF document containing the complete report (text, graphics, deduced observations, conclusions, etc.)
